text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: inference-eu-5xx-rate (priority: P1) — 23 alerts in 2m, auto-escalation enabled. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerbot: auto-ack not set, awaiting manual ack...

kayla: @pagerbot I'm claiming this. acked and entering triage :wave:

matt: Kayla — quick ask: is this across all EU dedicated pools or only eu-west-1? any customer 5xx spikes reported?

kayla: Initial check: Prometheus shows 5xx spike from embed-frontend route -> ~5% errors. CPU on pool-gpu-eu-2 at 85%. Logs show repeated timeout to dyn-kvcache.

kayla: paste log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:21Z] worker=pool-gpu-eu-2 req_id=abc123 status=500 err="kvcache: timeout after 2s"
[2026-03-17T12:03:23Z] worker=pool-gpu-eu-2 req_id=def456 status=200 cache_miss=true latency=420ms
```

devon: tagging as possible kvcache eviction storm. @sre-ops can you confirm if autoscaler bounced nodes?

sre-ops: Looking... autoscaler did trigger 1 scale-up at 12:02Z, no recent restarts. KVCACHE eviction logs show LRU thrash on host host-23.

kayla: Running warm-cache rollback on pool-gpu-eu-2 (rolling restart of kvcache tier) — will follow with coords. ETA ~4m.

matt: Notify customer ops? Any user-visible degradation?

kayla: Customer impact: degraded 5xx for small subset of embeddings requests (PLG bucket). We're seeing increased latency and errors for some tokenized embeddings. Not global outage. I'll open a support note if it persists.

devon: If restart doesn't fix within 8m, fallback route to smaller-quantized model in eu-west should be enabled. Matt can you prepare route toggle?

matt: On it — preparing canary rollback toggles. Command:
```
/run infra toggle-route --route embeddings-eu --variant model-quant-small --canary 10%
```

kayla: Restart applied to kvcache instances on host-23 and host-24. Monitoring.

incidentbot: Deploy log: kvcache@host-23 restart succeeded (12:06:08Z)

kayla: Error rate dropping to 1.2% now. Latency trending down. Keeping watch for 15m.

sre-ops: Noted. I'm leaving markers in the runbook and tagging SLO leads.

devon: Great work. If it resurfaces, I'll take over escalation. For now Kayla you're owner — handoff plan logged.

kayla: Acknowledged. I'll post a handoff summary at 12:25Z if stable. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: PD incident closed by Kayla (INC12345) — resolved: kvcache eviction fixed, autoscale behaved, fallback not needed.

matt: Thanks team. Customer ops, will draft an incident summary for the support ticket.

kayla: Summary for handoff: root cause probable kvcache LRU thrash due to burst traffic; mitigated by kvcache restart + autoscale; monitoring shows recovery. Next steps: add eviction metrics to alert thresholds + improve pre-warming during bursty loads.

devon: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-7892

kayla: Handoff complete. Ending thread.
